name: soi
description: IRS income & tax stats by ZIP: AGI distribution, tax, credits, deductions.
long_description: An MCP server that puts IRS Statistics of Income (SOI) data by ZIP code inside your agent. Pull the real income distribution across the six IRS AGI brackets, total and average AGI, income tax and total tax liability, refundable credits (EITC, additional child tax credit), and standard vs. itemized deductions — for any U.S. ZIP. SOI is aggregated from actual filed returns (not a survey estimate), so it reports income, tax, and credits the Census ACS can't. Read-only and built on public-domain IRS data — no API key. The dataset is bulk-downloaded once into a local store on first use, then served instantly offline. The ZIP release lags ~2–3 years; the latest available year loads by default.

tools.name: lookup_zip
tools.description: Confirm a ZIP has SOI data; returns state, returns, individuals, and the tax year.

tools.name: get_income
tools.description: Total AGI, average AGI per return, and the main income components.

tools.name: get_agi_distribution
tools.description: The six IRS AGI brackets for a ZIP — returns and AGI per bracket, plus each share.

tools.name: get_tax
tools.description: Income tax, total tax liability, total payments, and average total tax per return.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Refundable credits: the EITC (split by qualifying children) and additional child tax credit.

tools.name: get_deductions
tools.description: Standard vs. itemized deductions, the SALT deduction, and the % itemizing.

tools.name: get_filing_status
tools.description: Single / married-joint / head-of-household mix, elderly returns, and e-file share.

tools.name: compare_zips
tools.description: Rank several ZIPs by a single metric, highest first.

tools.name: get_state_totals
tools.description: State-level totals and AGI distribution from the IRS state-rollup row.

tools.name: get_soi_field
tools.description: Escape hatch: the raw value of any SOI field for a ZIP, by code or friendly name.
